title: Additional tax-domain playbook extension design
scope: Define governed extension contracts for PAYE, withholding, treaty/permanent-establishment and digital-services playbooks

acceptance.text: Define governed extension contracts for PAYE, withholding, treaty/permanent-establishment and digital-services playbooks
Each proposed domain names required sources, legal-review gate and evaluation fixtures before implementation
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Each proposed domain names required sources, legal-review gate and evaluation fixtures before implementation

evidence.text: ai/workflows/playbook_extensions.synthetic.json defines design-stage contracts for paye_reconciliation, withholding_review, treaty_pe_facts and digital_services_review (scope, deterministic checks, get_model roles, operations/provenance subsets of the TAX-061 allowlists, advisory finding codes, alternative explanations, budgets); ai/workflows/playbook_extensions.py loader refuses 20 policy violations and check_registry refuses a TAX-061 playbook entry for a blocked domain (ADR-033). tests/ai/test_playbook_extensions.py: 11 tests OK in .venv-ai.

Every domain names required_sources (system of record, v1 status), a legal_review_gate (rsl_legal_reviewer, open questions, reviewer) and six evaluation fixtures (legitimate, missing, contradictory, hostile, no verified route, cross-tenant); the loader rejects a domain missing any of them. python -m ai.workflows.playbook_extensions observed all four blocked: source_not_in_v1, legal_review_pending, finding_code_not_in_legal_registry, fixture_not_authored and (except digital services) contract_category_pending. test_readiness_clears_only_when_every_gate_is_met passes.

Observed locally on Windows: scripts/validate.py OK; .venv-ai unittest discover -s tests/ai 255 tests OK; ai.evaluation.agent_eval --check gate PASS (0 regressions); playbook_registry digests all ok (no registered source changed); every dev.py check step OK except the two known Windows file-mode tooling tests (438 != 384); quality.py ruff/format/mypy OK, Prettier fails only on pre-existing CRLF files. GitHub Actions cannot start (org billing limit).
